items.en: «Ігла» проти реактивного дрона: на Рівненщині «Герань-4» знищили із ПЗРК (ArmyInform: Igla versus a jet drone: Geran-4 destroyed with a MANPADS in Rivne region)
items.nl: Igla tegen een straaldrone: Geran-4 in de oblast Rivne neergehaald met een MANPADS
items.sEn: On the morning of 11 October, Ukrainian air defenders in Rivne region (north-western Ukraine) destroyed a Russian jet-powered Geran-4 drone, ArmyInform reports. According to a video released by Air Command West, the drone was shot down by Junior Sergeant Vasyl Rezanovych of the command's security battalion using an Ig…
